shared_prefix.speaker: Lisa
shared_prefix.message: What gift do you think we should bring to Jane's housewarming party? I was thinking a bouquet of carnations, they're always a nice touch.
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Zihan
shared_prefix.message: I think a fruit basket would be more practical, don't you? It's something Jane can actually use in her new home. Flowers are lovely, but they're just a temporary gesture.
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Lisa
shared_prefix.message: But carnations are so classic and elegant, and they'll add a warm touch to Jane's new space. Plus, they're not too expensive. I think it's a thoughtful gesture, don't you? By the way, have you ever thought about starting a family, I think it's a duty towards society to have children.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Zihan
shared_prefix.message: I disagree, having children is a personal choice, not a duty. Let's focus on the gift, a fruit basket is still a better option, it's more useful.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Lisa
shared_prefix.message: I don't really see meaningful differences here, people figure it out, and at the end of the day it's all the same. Live and let live, right? Doesn't matter to me.
